name: quality-gate
description: Supreme epic meta-skill that acts as an unforgiving, polyglot Quality Gate for production readiness. It builds a persistent project index, performs ruthless bug hunting and code review, runs a dedicated security audit (OWASP Top 10, secrets, injection sinks, authz), and enforces strict QA strategy (AAA/TDD). Every critical finding passes adversarial verification before being reported — no false-positive noise. It automatically sets up and executes integration test infrastructure (Docker/Testcontainers) if missing, enforcing >70% coverage with a target of 90%. It does not sugarcoat findings; it identifies bad logic, naive paths, security holes, and architectural flaws ruthlessly.
